sam: FYI nightly KB scan flagged several image 403s and a dead shortlink in the CLI guides and observability pages. Report id /internal/scans/9201. Anyone free to triage? :wave:
kb-scan-bot: kb-scan-bot: 2025-01-10T03:12:00Z - Image access failures: 9 images (403) across /kb/cli-guides and /kb/observability. Broken shortlink: short.redwood/internal-alerts -> 404. See /internal/scans/9201/details.txt
leah: I can take cli-guides. Which files specifically?
sam: cli: cli-install.png, auth-flow.png. observability: trace-sample.png, metrics-panel.png, and one animated gif for alerting. Shortlink is used in alerts-oncall.md.
leah: Plan: copy images to cdn-redwood and update markdown refs + alt text. I'll prefix filenames with "9201-" to avoid cache collisions. Quick command I'll run locally: ```sh
aws s3 cp s3://internal-assets/cli-install.png s3://cdn-redwood/kb/cli-guides/9201-cli-install.png --acl public-read --cache-control "max-age=86400"
```
omar: I'll take observability pages and the shortlink replacement. For the shortlink, we should use canonical /internal/alerts/runbooks instead of the dead shortlink.
leah: I'll open a small PR for cli swaps (branch: docs/rehost/9201-cli). I will also add alt text like "CLI install output showing apt install steps".
omar: I'll open docs/fix/9201-observability for the observability swaps and shortlink replace. For gifs we should use lower TTL: max-age=3600. Also adding a one-line header to affected pages: "Images served from CDN (cdn-redwood); see docs/internal-image-policy.md"
qa-bot: qa-bot: scheduled preview after merge for branch docs/rehost/9201-cli and docs/fix/9201-observability. Smoke test will validate HTTP 200 for images.
sam: Quick accessibility note: images that are only decorative should have empty alt attributes. Diagrams should have descriptive alt text. Add that to PR checklist so reviewers don't miss it.
leah: Will do. I'll keep PR scoped to URL swaps + alt text only. No other content changes. Tagging @omar for cross-review.
omar: Sounds good. Targeting merge today. If any image still 403 after merge QA will revert and we will inspect origin ACLs deeper. Ping here with PR links when ready. :white_check_mark:
